Signature.purpose: Docs-site link that separates in-repo from external targets
Signature.description: Docs-site override of the default MDLink: a link with a host opens in a new tab and is badged as external, while a link without one is resolved inside the site through BookIndexTreeService instead of leaving the page.

Prop.description: Link target as written in the document
Host parsed out of the target; empty for an in-repo link

a.class: inline-block mx-1 px-1 font-bold link link-primary
